Create a radial bar chart.

Source: R/radial_bar_chart.R
radial_bar_chart.Rd

A radial bar chart (sometimes called a multi-ring progress chart or "activity rings") draws each category as a concentric circular track. A faint background track shows the full scale, and a colored arc with rounded ends sweeps along it in proportion to the category's value relative to max. It is a compact way to compare a handful of progress or completion rates. The look is inspired by the radialBar chart of the ApexCharts JavaScript library, reimplemented here in plain D3.

The first row of data is drawn as the outermost ring. The arcs sweep in on load, each ring is labelled at the start of its track, and the center shows the average (or total) of the values. Hovering a ring highlights it, replaces the center text with that ring's name and value, and shows a tooltip.

By default the rings cover 270 degrees (startAngle = 0, endAngle = 270), leaving the top-left quadrant free for the ring labels. Angles are in degrees, measured clockwise from 12 o'clock. Use endAngle = 360 for full circles (labels then follow the curve of each track), or for example startAngle = -90, endAngle = 90 for a semicircle gauge.

Usage

radial_bar_chart(
  data,
  label,
  value,
  max = 100,
  startAngle = 0,
  endAngle = 270,
  colors = NULL,
  trackCol = "#ececec",
  hollow = 0.35,
  ringGap = 0.3,
  roundedCaps = TRUE,
  showLabels = TRUE,
  showValues = TRUE,
  labelFontSize = 12,
  centerValue = c("average", "total", "none"),
  centerLabel = NULL,
  centerFontSize = NULL,
  valueFormat = ",.0f",
  suffix = NULL,
  hover = TRUE,
  animate = TRUE,
  duration = 1200,
  title = NULL,
  titleFontSize = 16,
  font = "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif",
  bgcol = "white",
  textCol = "#333333",
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL
)

Arguments

data

The data frame containing the variables to consider (one row per ring).

label

The name of the column holding the ring labels.

value

The name of the numeric (non-negative) column holding the ring values.

max

The value that corresponds to a full sweep of the track. Values above max are capped at a full sweep (with a warning). Defaults to 100.

startAngle

Angle in degrees at which every track starts, measured clockwise from 12 o'clock. Defaults to 0.

endAngle

Angle in degrees at which every track ends. Must be greater than startAngle and at most startAngle + 360. Defaults to 270.

colors

Optional. A vector of colors, one per ring (recycled if shorter). Defaults to NULL, which uses a built-in palette.

trackCol

Color of the background tracks. Defaults to "#ececec".

hollow

Size of the empty center as a fraction (0 to 0.9) of the outer radius. Defaults to 0.35.

ringGap

Fraction (0 to 0.9) of each ring's band left empty between neighbouring tracks. Defaults to 0.3.

roundedCaps

Whether the arcs (and partial tracks) have rounded ends. Defaults to TRUE.

showLabels

Whether to label each ring at the start of its track. Defaults to TRUE.

showValues

Whether to append the formatted value to each ring label (e.g. "Vimeo: 76%"). Defaults to TRUE.

labelFontSize

Font size of the ring labels. Defaults to 12.

centerValue

What to show in the center when nothing is hovered: "average" (default), "total" or "none".

centerLabel

Optional. Text shown above the center value. Defaults to "Average" or "Total" depending on centerValue.

centerFontSize

Optional. Font size of the big center value. Defaults to NULL, which sizes it to fit the hollow.

valueFormat

A d3-format specifier used to display values. Defaults to ",.0f".

suffix

Optional. Text appended to every displayed value. Defaults to NULL, which uses "%" when max = 100 and nothing otherwise.

hover

Whether hovering a ring highlights it, updates the center text and shows a tooltip. Defaults to TRUE.

animate

Whether the arcs sweep in on first render. Defaults to TRUE.

duration

Duration of the sweep animation in milliseconds. Defaults to 1200.

title

Optional. Title of the chart.

titleFontSize

Font size of the chart title. Defaults to 16.

font

The font family used for all text. Defaults to "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif".

bgcol

Background color of the SVG. Defaults to "white".

textCol

Color of the title, labels and center text. Defaults to "#333333".

width

Optional. The width of the SVG output.

height

Optional. The height of the SVG output.

Value

An SVG radial bar chart.

Examples

# Share of users active on each platform (percentages)
platforms <- data.frame(
  platform = c("Vimeo", "Messenger", "Facebook", "LinkedIn"),
  share    = c(76, 67, 61, 90)
)

radial_bar_chart(
  data  = platforms,
  label = "platform",
  value = "share",
  title = "Weekly active users (share of total)"
)



# Full circles, total in the center, custom colors and a custom maximum
sales <- data.frame(
  region = c("North", "South", "East", "West", "Central"),
  units  = c(420, 310, 275, 190, 120)
)

radial_bar_chart(
  data        = sales,
  label       = "region",
  value       = "units",
  max         = 500,
  endAngle    = 360,
  centerValue = "total",
  centerLabel = "Units sold",
  colors      = c("#1b9e77", "#d95f02", "#7570b3", "#e7298a", "#66a61e"),
  title       = "Units sold by region (target: 500)"
)



# Gauge layout open at the bottom, without values in the ring labels
radial_bar_chart(
  data       = platforms,
  label      = "platform",
  value      = "share",
  startAngle = -135,
  endAngle   = 135,
  hollow     = 0.45,
  showValues = FALSE,
  trackCol   = "#f2f2f2"
)
